beforeYouBuy.h2: Before you buy — the honest version

device.strong: Your phone needs to support eSIM and be carrier-unlocked.
device.rest: Dial *#06# — if you see an EID number, you're fine.

dataOnly.rest: You won't get a local phone number and you can't send or receive standard SMS. WhatsApp, iMessage, Telegram and Signal all work normally over data.

roaming.rest: alongside the eSIM. Just turn off data roaming on your main line, or your home operator will still charge you.

wifi.strong: You'll need Wi-Fi to install it
wifi.rest: , so do it before you leave.

residence.strong: You can't use a Roamly eSIM in your own country of residence.

speeds.strong: Speeds depend on the local networks
speeds.rest: we partner with. Coverage is strong in cities and can be weaker in remote areas.

compatibility.fallback: Don't see your model? Dial *#06# on your phone — if an EID number appears, your phone supports eSIM. It also needs to be carrier-unlocked.

notes.iphone-us-carrier: US carrier models are often locked to one operator. Check with your carrier.
notes.galaxy-a: eSIM support varies by market and model — check your exact model number.
notes.galaxy-us-variant: US variants of some models ship without eSIM. Check your model number.
notes.budget-android: eSIM is mainly on flagship models. Dial *#06# to check yours.

trust.h2: We're new. Here's why you can trust us anyway.
trust.body: Roamly launched in {year}. We don't have a hundred thousand reviews yet — the companies that do took years to get them. What we can offer instead is a straight deal: transparent per-GB pricing, a human who answers, and a refund if your eSIM doesn't connect. If we get something wrong, tell us at {email} and we'll fix it.

compatible.question: Will it work on my phone?
compatible.answer: Most phones released after 2018 support eSIM. Dial *#06# — if an EID number appears, your phone is compatible. Your phone also needs to be carrier-unlocked. If you're not sure, check with your home operator before buying.

own-number.question: Do I keep my own phone number?
own-number.answer: Yes. Your eSIM runs alongside your normal SIM. Your number, contacts, WhatsApp and iMessage all stay exactly as they are.

calls-texts.question: Can I make calls or send texts?
calls-texts.answer: Not standard calls or SMS — Roamly plans are data only. You can call and message freely through WhatsApp, Signal, Telegram, FaceTime and similar apps.

when-starts.question: When does my plan start?
when-starts.answer: When your eSIM first connects to a network in your destination, not when you buy it. So you can buy weeks ahead without losing days.

when-install.question: When should I install it?
when-install.answer: Before you fly, while you have Wi-Fi. Install it, then leave it switched off until you land.

delivery-speed.question: How fast is delivery?
delivery-speed.answer: Within {minutes} minutes, by email, any time of day.

lost-qr.question: What if I delete the QR code?
lost-qr.answer: Email us at {email} and we'll resend it. Keep the confirmation email — a QR code can usually only be installed once.

hotspot.question: Can I use a hotspot?
hotspot.answer: Yes, on most plans. Check the plan description before buying — a few destinations restrict hotspot/tethering at the network level.

check-data.question: How do I check how much data is left?
check-data.answer: In your phone's mobile data settings, under the Roamly eSIM line. A self-serve usage page is on our roadmap.

data-runs-out.question: What happens when my data runs out?
data-runs-out.answer: The connection stops. You can buy a top-up or a new plan at any time.

refund.question: Can I get a refund?
refund.answer: Yes, in these cases: your phone turned out not to be compatible, your trip was cancelled and the eSIM was never installed, or the eSIM failed to connect and we couldn't fix it. Refunds go back to the card you paid with within {window}. Full terms on our Refund Policy page.

multi-country.question: Can I use one eSIM for several countries?
multi-country.answer: Yes — our Europe regional plan covers 33 countries on a single eSIM. Single-country destinations cover that one country only.

networks.question: Which networks will I connect to?
networks.answer: We work with local operators in each destination. The partner networks are listed on each plan page.

privacy.question: What data do you collect?
privacy.answer: Your email address and your purchase details, so we can deliver your eSIM and support you. We can't see your browsing, your messages or your calls. Full details in our Privacy Policy.

about.title: About Roamly
about.subtitle: A straight deal on travel data: transparent pricing, a human who answers, and a refund if it doesn't work.
about.s1b: Travel eSIM pricing is usually a maze of "from €X" teasers, auto-renewing plans and hidden per-GB costs. Roamly launched in {year} to do the opposite: one visible price per plan, per-GB comparison built into every card, and nothing that renews without you asking for it.
about.s2b: We don't operate mobile networks ourselves. Roamly is a reseller: we buy data capacity from an eSIM aggregator with agreements across local operators worldwide, and package it into simple, fixed-price plans for travellers.
about.s3b: Questions, feedback, or a partnership idea — write to {email}.

whatIsEsim.title: What is an eSIM?
whatIsEsim.subtitle: An eSIM is a digital SIM card built into your phone. Instead of a physical card you insert, you install it by scanning a QR code.
whatIsEsim.s1h: How it's different from a physical SIM
whatIsEsim.s1b: A physical SIM is a small plastic card you swap in and out of your phone. An eSIM is software — it lives on a chip already inside your phone. Installing one takes a QR code scan and a couple of taps, not a trip to a kiosk or a SIM ejector tool.
whatIsEsim.s2b: You keep your home SIM active for calls and texts on your own number, and run a Roamly eSIM alongside it purely for mobile data in your destination. No roaming charges from your home carrier, no hunting for a local SIM shop after a long flight.
whatIsEsim.s3b: Most phones released after 2018 support eSIM. Dial *#06# — if an EID number appears, your phone is compatible. Check your exact model below.
whatIsEsim.s4b: Roamly connects you to local mobile operators in each destination through our eSIM aggregator partner. The specific partner network for each destination is confirmed at checkout and in your delivery email, and can change if we switch providers to improve coverage or price. Coverage is generally strongest in and around cities.

installationGuide.title: Installation guide
installationGuide.subtitle: Install before you fly, while you still have Wi-Fi. Then leave it switched off until you land.
installationGuide.ios1: Open the QR code email we sent you on a computer or another phone.
installationGuide.ios2: On your iPhone, go to Settings → Cellular → Add eSIM (on older iOS versions: Settings → Mobile Data → Add eSIM).
installationGuide.ios3: Choose Use QR Code and scan the code from the email.
installationGuide.ios4: Follow the prompts, and label the new line "Roamly" or your destination name.
installationGuide.ios5: Under Cellular Plans, set your home line as default for calls/iMessage and the Roamly eSIM for data — then turn on Data Roaming for the Roamly line only.
installationGuide.android1: Open the QR code email we sent you on a computer or another phone.
installationGuide.android2: Go to Settings → Network & Internet → SIMs (menus vary slightly by manufacturer) and tap Add eSIM / Add network.
installationGuide.android3: Choose Scan QR code and scan the code from the email.
installationGuide.android4: Follow the prompts to finish installation.
installationGuide.android5: Make sure mobile data is enabled for the Roamly eSIM, and data roaming is turned on for that line specifically.
installationGuide.noQrBody: Every delivery email also includes a manual activation code you can type in directly — look for "Enter details manually" in your phone's eSIM setup screen.
installationGuide.stuckBody: Email us at {email} with your order confirmation and a screenshot of where you're stuck — we'll walk you through it.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.s1b: Roamly ({entity}, {registration}, {address}) sells prepaid mobile data eSIMs for international travel. We are a reseller: we do not operate our own mobile network.
terms.s2b: Each plan is a fixed amount of mobile data, valid for a fixed number of days from first network connection, for a named destination. Plans are data only — no voice calls, no SMS, no local phone number. Plans do not renew automatically.
terms.s3b: Your eSIM is delivered by email as a QR code and manual activation code, normally within {minutes} minutes of successful payment. No physical item is shipped.
terms.s4b: You're responsible for confirming your device is eSIM-compatible and carrier-unlocked before you buy. See our Refund Policy for what happens if it turns out not to be.
terms.s5b: Payments are processed by Stripe. We do not store your card details. Charges appear on your statement as {descriptor}.
terms.s6b: Roamly is not liable for network coverage or speed at your destination, which depends on our local operator partners, or for losses arising from your device being incompatible or locked. Our liability for any claim is limited to the amount you paid for the relevant plan.
